configurationFields.label: Inital Map
configurationFields.description: Sets the map to start the server with. If "Custom" is selected, Custom Initial Map must also be specified

configurationFields.label: Custom Initial Map
configurationFields.description: Sets a custom map to use for the Initial Map, if "Custom" is selected

configurationFields.label: Mod Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the mod directory to load, allowing the use of third-party Sven Co-op mods. Don't change this from the default 'svencoop' unless you know what you are doing!

configurationFields.label: Disable Valve Anti-Cheat
configurationFields.description: If set, Valve Anti-Cheat (VAC) will be disabled

configurationFields.label: Show Spectator Talk To All Players
Additional Command Line Parameters
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional [command line parameters](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Command_line_options#Command-Line_Parameters_6) (anything that begins with a -) that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Use with care

configurationFields.label: Additional Console Variables
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional [console variables](https://wiki.svencoop.com/Console/Variables) (anything that begins with a +) that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Use with care. Preferably, specify the equivalent under "Additional Server Settings"

configurationFields.label: Additional Server Settings
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional settings to include in "server.cfg" that are not otherwise set by GSCS. One setting per line

configurationFields.label: Install Opposing Force Support
configurationFields.description: If set, support for Half Life: Opposing Force will be installed when the server is updated. This is required for some maps to work correctly. You must own Half Life: Opposing Force on Steam for this to work

configurationFields.label: Install Blue Shift Support
configurationFields.description: If set, support for Half Life: Blue Shift will be installed when the server is updated. This is required for some maps to work correctly. You must own Half Life: Blue Shift on Steam for this to work

authenticationRequirements.label: Steam-Konto
authenticationRequirements.description: Ein Steam-Konto mit Berechtigung für dieses Spiel hinterlegen. Steam Guard kann einmalig erforderlich sein.
